target_customer: UK trades and field service businesses (heating, electrical, fire and security, facilities) with call volume and engineer scheduling
problem: Trades firms miss calls out of hours and burn staff time on scheduling, confirmations and job notes. Elyos sells autonomous AI agents for these tasks.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for AI agents across voice, email and scheduling
product_category: Vertical AI agents for field services

founders.name: Adrian Johnston
education: Oxford, BA and MMath in Mathematics (as stated on YC page: bachelor's and master's)
previous_startups: Una Brands (YC page: reached $70m ARR and raised $100m)
founders.background_notes: YC launch post says he optimized call centres at BCG.

founders.name: Philippa Brown
founders.background_notes: Ran operations for over 1,000 engineers per YC launch post.

founders.name: Panos Stravopodis
founders.background_notes: Over 15 years leading engineering teams per YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice and email agents had to be reliable with live calls and integrate with field service CRMs; the 2023 LLM wave made the core feasible for a small team but production quality was hard.

defensibility.rationale: Integrations with field service systems and a UK trades focus help, but voice agent tooling was easy to copy and many rivals appeared.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: A 2026 comparison says field service platforms ship their own AI receptionists; Elyos still raised a Series A in January 2026.

market_need_then: UK trades firms faced missed calls and heavy admin; company claims cost base cuts above 30% and over 80% lead conversion (self-reported, 2026).

identity.voice_and_tone: Positions itself as 'The AI Workforce built for trades & field services'.

branding.community_and_virality: Runs a community via Luma and is active on X and LinkedIn per its site.

brand_strength.rationale: Branding search found trademark filings and an unrelated Elyos Energy building-energy firm with the same name, but no press on the brand itself.

outcome_analysis: Elyos AI is an active London company that used the 2023 LLM wave to sell agents to trades firms, backed by founders with operations experience at OVO and a prior scaled company. It raised a $13M Series A led by Blackbird in January 2026, with the company stating about $16M total. Crowded voice agent competition is the main risk.
notes: A $3M seed in October 2023 appears only on Welcome to the Jungle and one aggregator, so unverified and not recorded; the company's stated total of about $16M is consistent with it, hence partial. Lead investor differs on Seedtable (Y Combinator) versus press (Blackbird); press used. Competitor sources found were all dated 2026, so the at-founding list is empty. The legal entity is Elyos Energy UK Ltd, and an unrelated Elyos Energy product exists; not verified as related.
